name: Zenra de Enkaigei o Saserareta Shinjin OL
original_name: 全裸で宴会芸をさせられた新人OL
source:
This time, the main character has a girl for whom he has a feeling secretly and he sees her humiliated with a finger in his mouth...
She goes through very humiliating situations during a freshman-welcoming party...
